8. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Duties of a Cold Weather Patrolman: The dutics of a Patrolman undertaking cold weather patrolling are as follows a. Patrol the track during the coldest part of the night and lookout for weld/rail fractures and excessi ve gaps at SEJ. b. Protect the track at the site of weld/rail fractures, or excessive gaps at SEJ, or shearing/snappin g of bolts; and report to nearest Station Master, JE/SSE/P.Way. C. On single linc: walk over the beat slowly along one rail in one direction and on the other rail in the return direction. On double line; repeat this procedure alternately on UP and DN tracks. d. Be vigilant and look out for rail/weld failure, or excessive gaps at SEJ, or shearing/snapping of bolts etc. e. In case it is noticed that a rail/weld failure has occurred or gap at SEJ becomes more than the designed maximum gap. the patrolman will take immediate action to suspend the traffic and protect the line. After protecting the rack. the patrolman will arr ange to report to Keyman/Gangmate, JE/SSEP.Way. and Station Master of adjacent station. Only competent staff to be provided by the agency because they have move on tr

ack with railway patrolman and trains will be running on track. All safety and protective gears like torch, Retro-reflecting Jacket, winter Jacket, Safety Shoes and Safety Stick etc to be provided by agency at their own cost. All cold weather patrolman companion provided by agency should be in proper uniform. The person so provided will be on the pay roll of the placement agency and their engagement does not constitute any offer of appointment in Indian Railway. The person engaged to provide the service should maintain strict discipline, integrity and should be well behaved. The agency shall be responsible for the behavior of such personnel provided. Th e agency shall, for the purpose of fulfilling the conditions of agreement, provide personnel of g ood character, physically and mentally fit, alert, in sound health, well behaved, well trained and s kilful intheir duties. The agency shall exercise proper supervision on the conduct of personn el engaged underthis contract. Railway shall not deal with the personnel providing servi ces, directly, in case of any misconduct etc. which shall be reported to the agency. The contractor will be fully responsible for making good any loss/damagelavoidable detention causes due to failure on the part of companion. If the agency intends to withdraw the services of the personnel referred to 14. replacement above, at least to be prior provided notice with shall the approval be given of in Railway. writing Railway and a can suitable order change of the personnel provided if not found suitable for the job. Railway will make payment to the agency on completion of each month against the invoices rai sedby the agency. The personnel shall fulfil the reguirement of work as per the guidelines issued by the railway official. The personnel will have to attend duty in LKO division section of Northern Railway. No TA/DA will be paid for the purpose. The personnel should remain contactable on mobile phone for which mobile phone with call outgoing facility shall be provided to the personnel by agency. The mobile number shall be communicated to concerned P Way supervisor. The duration is approximate and actual payment will be made on the basis of actual man days services utilized . The patrolling shall be done in pair where one railway man and one companion shall be deputed. The patrolling shall be governed by provision for cold weather patrolling and duties of Patrol men. as mentioned in IRPWM and Railway circulars / letters time to time, in this connection.
